# Security Audit Kit

> Cross-platform, configuration-driven web/API security testing automation (DAST + SCA),
> non-destructive with automatic rollback, with consultant-grade IT security reports.
> Open source (Apache-2.0), made by hadymaggot.

Entry point: `python audit.py <module>` (identical on Windows/Linux/macOS). Credentials via
environment variables. References: OWASP Top 10 2021, OWASP API Security Top 10 2023, ASVS.

## Modules
- access control / BOPLA (authz, mass-assignment), injection (SQLi), upload, auth-policy
- client-leak, cors, open-redirect, tls, headers, webstack (banner to CVE), deps (Trivy/semgrep/gitleaks), zap
- Destructive tests (e.g. mass-assignment) are restored automatically through the rollback journal.
